`final class BridgeHandler`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [BridgeHandler.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/BridgeHandler.java)

The static registries through which the core of JOID reaches its bridges, one registry per kind of bridge.

## Description

Each constant is a [`BridgeRegistry`](/reference/bridges/bridgeregistry/) of one kind of bridge.
Before any backend, JOID registers a [`SystemClockBridge`](/reference/bridges/systemclockbridge/) in `CLOCK`, a [`DirectThreadBridge`](/reference/bridges/directthreadbridge/) in `THREAD` and an identity bridge in `SIGNAL_REPLAY`; [`Backend.register`](/reference/backends/backend/#Backend-method-register) fills the others.
Your code reaches a registry when it needs a bridge directly, to read one or to add one:

```java file="com/example/running/PanelPlugin.java" region="ready"
```

## Constant and field details

<a id="BridgeHandler-constant-UI"></a>

### UI

`UIBridgeRegistry UI` 

The UI bridges, which hold the open UIs, receive the input and draw every frame.
Unlike the other registries, JOID uses all of its bridges at once, by priority.

<a id="BridgeHandler-constant-AUDIO"></a>

### AUDIO

`BridgeRegistry<IAudioBridge> AUDIO` 

The audio bridge that plays the sound of videos.
It stays empty when the backend is built with `audio(false)`.

<a id="BridgeHandler-constant-CLOCK"></a>

### CLOCK

`BridgeRegistry<IClockBridge> CLOCK` 

The clock that animations, tweens, media and drags read.
It holds a [`SystemClockBridge`](/reference/bridges/systemclockbridge/) until a bridge of higher priority is registered, such as a [`ManualClockBridge`](/reference/bridges/manualclockbridge/) in a test.

<a id="BridgeHandler-constant-WINDOW"></a>

### WINDOW

`BridgeRegistry<IWindowBridge> WINDOW` 

The window bridge: size of the drawable surface, mouse position, held keys, clipboard and cursor.

<a id="BridgeHandler-constant-RENDER"></a>

### RENDER

`BridgeRegistry<IRenderBridge> RENDER` 

The render bridge, which draws every pixel and creates the textures, framebuffers and shaders.

<a id="BridgeHandler-constant-THREAD"></a>

### THREAD

`BridgeRegistry<IThreadBridge> THREAD` 

The thread bridge, which names the render thread and runs the tasks of other threads on it.
It holds a [`DirectThreadBridge`](/reference/bridges/directthreadbridge/) until the backend registers its own.

<a id="BridgeHandler-constant-SIGNAL_REPLAY"></a>

### SIGNAL_REPLAY

`BridgeRegistry<ISignalReplayBridge> SIGNAL_REPLAY` 

The bridge that maps the names compiled in a reactive expression to the names that exist at run time.
It holds an identity bridge until a host that renames classes registers its own.
